packageRules.description: compose-ai-tools ships the preview CLI, the ee.schimke.composeai Gradle artifacts (preview-annotations dep + the ee.schimke.composeai.preview plugin marker), and the reusable CI composite actions as a single release. Track it aggressively so CI always runs the latest renderer: group the pinned action refs and the Gradle coords into ONE PR so the CLI/plugin/dependency pins never skew apart, skip the weekly window, and automerge as soon as CI is green — the release moves several times a day and the pin is only useful if it keeps up. Regenerating the published catalog against the new renderer no longer depends on WHO merges: design-artifacts.yml has a push trigger on main covering the pins this PR touches, so a Renovate merge (app token — raises `push`) republishes on its own, and scheduled-merge.yml still dispatches design-artifacts.yml explicitly for the merges it makes itself (GITHUB_TOKEN merges raise no `push` event).
